exposure: maternal dose of buprenorphine at delivery
outcome: incidence of pharmacologic treatment of NAS
cohort: The study included 155 maternal-infant dyads exposed to buprenorphine during pregnancy.
finding: The study found no dose-response relationship between maternal buprenorphine dose at delivery and any of the 9 measured neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Method of delivery was examined as an outcome, but no relationship was found with maternal buprenorphine dose at delivery.
birth_weight: Birthweight was measured as an outcome.
gest_age: Gestational age was measured as an outcome.
